profile.title: Your profile
profile.avatarsHint: Tap a free photo to equip it. Dark photos with a lock are locked: win matches at the table. The number is how many wins you need in total.
profile.cartoonsHint: Tap a free photo to equip it. Dark photos with a lock are locked: win matches at the table. The number is how many wins you need in total.
profile.cartoonsEmpty: Empty for now. Drop your JPGs in client/public/assets/avatars/cartoon/ (name-without-spaces.jpg) and reload — they show up on their own.

rules.title: House rules
rules.stackHint: +2 on +2 and +4 on +4. If you can't, you take the pile.
rules.chaos70Hint: 7 swaps hands. 0 rotates every hand in play direction.
rules.blitzHint: 10 seconds per turn. Miss it and you draw 1.
rules.jumpInHint: Same card? Slam it even if it's not your turn.
rules.seriesHint: First to win 3 rounds takes the table.

preset.chaosHint: Watch it all burn. Stack, jump-in and 7/0.
